previousRule: The sample-to-sale staff route requires SUPPLIER_ADMIN, while the owner's signed-in account has only CURTAINSUK_ERROR_CENTRE_VIEWER. The Content Admin card is visible, but the private pilot cannot open for the owner.
newRule: The sample-to-sale GET and POST routes accept either SUPPLIER_ADMIN or the dedicated CURTAINSUK_SAMPLE_TO_SALE_MANAGER role. The dedicated role does not authorize supplier administration. All customer eligibility, delivery, consent, purchase-history, switch and code checks remain in place.
reason: The owner requested a usable private sample-to-sale pilot and demonstrated that the Content Admin link led to a staff access message. A narrowly scoped role fixes access without granting broader supplier administration.
ownerApprovedDecision: Owner review is requested for this sample-pilot access policy and its protected test. The repository requires an exact-head Nylon1 comment on this PR before merge; this field does not substitute for that comment.
